headline: Names a Bronx, New York Postal Service building after Dr. Roscoe C. Brown, Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2024 Jerome Avenue in the Bronx as the "Dr. Roscoe C. Brown, Jr. Post Office Building." It is an honorary name change and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, postal rules, and staffing stay the same.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on December 16, 2016.
